scripts.setup: npm run fastapi:setup && npm run react:setup
scripts.check: npm run fastapi:check && npm run react:check
scripts.test: npm run fastapi:test && npm run react:test
scripts.fastapi:setup: cd shakestir-fastapi && uv sync --locked --extra dev && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && uv run db-setup
scripts.fastapi:lint: cd shakestir-fastapi && uv run ruff check .
scripts.fastapi:format: cd shakestir-fastapi && uv run ruff format .
scripts.fastapi:format:check: cd shakestir-fastapi && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.fastapi:check: npm run fastapi:lint && npm run fastapi:format:check
scripts.react:check: npm run react:lint && npm run react:build
